fields.title: Checkout revamp / 结算流程改版
fields.goal: Shoppers finish checkout in under a minute, with coupons, saved addresses and Apple Pay. / 用户一分钟内完成结算：支持优惠码、地址簿和 Apple Pay。
fields.latest-update: Coupons and duplicate-order fix shipped. Apple Pay has not started, so the 11-06 date is at risk. / 优惠码和重复下单修复已上线。Apple Pay 尚未开始，11-06 的目标日期有风险。

fields.title: Invoice v2 / 发票 2.0
fields.goal: Customers receive correct, itemised invoices for every legal entity. / 客户在每个法人主体下都能收到正确、含明细的发票。
fields.latest-update: PDF invoices shipped and wait for Finance to accept; numbering per entity is in review. / PDF 发票已上线，等待财务验收；按主体编号正在评审。

fields.title: Q4 payment reliability / Q4 支付稳定性
fields.goal: No lost payments and no public API outages during the holiday peak. / 节日高峰期间不丢支付、公共接口不宕机。
fields.latest-update: Webhook retries shipped. Rate limiting is four days late, blocked on the gateway config change. / 回调重试已上线。接口限流晚了四天，卡在网关配置变更上。

fields.title: Refund self-service / 退款自助
fields.goal: Support agents settle a refund request without asking engineering. / 客服无需找研发就能处理完一笔退款申请。
